text: “The data you seek is rarely in the element you expect — inspect twice, select once.”
author: Selena Selector

text: “A polite crawler waits between requests; an impolite one waits in the IP ban list.”
author: Robo T. Texter

text: “Behind every single-page app is a JSON API quietly doing all the work.”
author: Ajax Jasonson

text: “Regex on HTML is a love story that always ends in tears. Use a parser.”
author: Selena Selector

text: “If the selector broke overnight, the site shipped a redesign — anchor on meaning, not on markup.”
author: Cassandra Cache

text: “robots.txt is not a lock — it is a handshake. Shake hands.”
author: Robo T. Texter

text: “Cache what you crawl; the second request is always the rude one.”
author: Cassandra Cache

text: “An empty result set is not a bug report. Print the HTML you actually received.”
author: Ajax Jasonson
